prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry, channels, and whether you need strategy, data/ML engineering, creative, or full-funnel performance. I can recommend agencies once I know what matters most to you. A few quick questions first:

- What is your main goal? (brand awareness, e‑commerce growth, lead gen, personalization/CRM, ad optimization, etc.)
- Monthly/annual budget range?
- Industry and company size (startup, mid‑market, enterprise)?
- Which channels matter most? (paid search/social, display/programmatic, email, on‑site personalization, CRM)
- Do you need in‑house model development / MLOps or primarily AI-powered tools + strategy?

If you want a fast starting point, these types of LA agencies are frequently used for AI-driven marketing work:

- Wpromote — LA‑based performance marketing agency known for data-driven paid search/paid social and using machine learning for optimization.
- R/GA — full‑service creative + technology agency (LA office). Strong at blending creative with data/AI capabilities for large brands.
- Merkle — data‑driven CRM and customer experience agency (part of dentsu) with strong analytics and personalization work.
- Cognitiv — AI-powered ad optimization platform and partner for programmatic/paid media (works with agencies/brands).
- Tinuiti — performance marketing and e‑commerce agency with advanced analytics and automation capabilities.
- Accenture Song / Deloitte Digital — large consultancies with ML/AI engineering, marketing technology stacks, and enterprise integrations.

How to pick (quick checklist)
- Case studies & measurable outcomes specific to your industry.
- Technical capability: in-house data science, MLOps, or just tool integrations?
- Creative & UX abilities if personalization/creative optimization is important.
- Transparency on data access, models used, and KPIs.
- Contract flexibility, reporting cadence, and team structure.
- References from similar clients and a short pilot project option.

If you tell me your answers to the questions above (or at least your primary goal and budget), I’ll produce a tailored short list of 3–5 LA agencies with reasons they’d fit and what to ask them in an RFP or initial call.
